name: Wang Jianfeng
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes real-time (former) (2023); Forbes annual (2014-2025); Hurun Global (2016-2026); Hurun China (2014-2026)
forbes_bio: Wang Jianfeng chairs Ningbo Joyson, a manufacturer of automotive accessories.
Wang is an avid photographer whose work has been exhibited in the Ningbo Museum of Art.
Joyson is headquartered in the coastal Chinese city of Ningbo.

name: Philip O'Doherty
forbes_bio: Philip O'Doherty is the founder of E&I Engineering, an Irish IT company that he sold to Vertix Holdings in 2021 for almost $2 billlion in cash and stock.
O?Doherty founded E&I in 1987 and owned about 80% of the business at the time of the sale to Vertix.
The Queen's University graduate worked as an engineer for DuPont out in Campsie, Ireland for five years before venturing out on his own.
When he sold E&I, the company had over 30 locations worldwide, sales of $460m and more than 2,100 employees.

name: Shigenobu Nagamori
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2007-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026)
forbes_bio: Shigenobu Nagamori is the founder and chairman of motor manufacturer Nidec.
Nidec bills itself as the world's largest manufacturer of motors for hard-disk drives and optical drives, by units sold.
Nagamori has said publicly that his goal is to hit ¥10 trillion ($91 billion) in revenue by 2030, partly by focusing on drivetrains for electric vehicles.
In 2024, Mitsuya Kishida, one of five executive vice presidents, became the new president and CEO.

Nidec was removed from Nikkei 225 and Topix indexes in November 2025. The exchange marks it a "security on special alert" due partly to lax internal controls and an ongoing investigation over accounting scandal at one of its subsidiaries.

name: Robert Mouawad
forbes_bio: Robert Mouawad inherited the family's eponymous high-end jewelry business that his grandfather founded in Beirut in 1890.
He turned over management of the business to his sons Fred, Alain and Pascal in 2010.
Mouawad boasts one of the world's most dazzling gem collections, including Dynasty, a 51.12 carat Russian diamond estimated at nearly $10 million.
Robert Mouawad also owns real estate, including hotels in Beirut. He developed luxury residences on Reef Island, a man-made island in Bahrain.
forbes_facts: Mouawad has a private museum in a 110 year-old Beirut palace displaying his collection of Roman and Phoenician antiquities.
In 2024, Mouawad announced a partnership with Dubai-based developer Dar Global to build a luxury residential development in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Mori Arkin
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2013-2025); Hurun Global (2018-2026); Wikidata (2021)
forbes_bio: Mori Arkin got his start in business in 1972 helping his father run a small Israeli pharmaceutical distribution company.
The Arkins eventually moved into generic drug manufacturing, founding Agis Industries.
In 2004, they sold Agis to U.S. pharmaceutical company Perrigo for $818 million in cash and stock.
Still bullish on healthcare, he oversaw a January 2018 public offering on Nasdaq of Sol-Gel Technologies, a dermatology company. He owns over 62%.
forbes_facts: His two sons are involved in the family business; his daughter is serving in the Israel Defense Forses.
Arkin is an art history buff and enjoys composing music as a hobby.

name: Li Xuhui
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes real-time (former) (2023); Forbes annual (2018-2025); Hurun Global (2018-2023); Hurun China (2014-2023); Hurun Self-Made Women (2018-2020)
forbes_bio: Li Xuhui was a director and vice president of Foshan Haitian Flavouring and Food before she left in 2016.
Li managed Haitian's oyster sauce factory from 1999 to 2010.
Pang Kang and Cheng Xue, chairman and vice chairman of Haitian, are also billionaires.

name: Zhang Shengwei
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2025); Hurun China (2026)
forbes_bio: Zhang Shengwei is the founder and majority owner of Shenzhen iMiracle Technology, a Shenzhen-based electronic cigarette manufacturer.
Shenzhen iMiracle Technology produces brands including Elf Bar and Lost Mary; Shengwei also owns stakes in the firms behind Air Bar and Geekvape.
Zhang sold kitchenware and clothing on eBay before turning to vaping devices.

name: Salil Singhal
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2020-2025); Hurun Global (2016-2026); Hurun India (2015-2022)
forbes_bio: Salil Singhal is the chairman emeritus of PI Industries, a maker of plant protection and nutrient products.
The company was founded by his father, P.P.Singhal, in 1946 to manufacture edible oils.
Singhal's son, Mayank, is the CEO and has been involved with PI Industries since 1996.
forbes_facts: PI Industries started as Mewar Oil & General Mills in India's lake city of Udaipur.
The company has a network of more than 10,000 distributors and 70,000 retailers across India.

name: Michael Krasny
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2001-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026)
forbes_bio: Michael Krasny founded Computer Discount Warehouse (CDW) in 1984 as an online store for IT products.
In 2007, he sold the company to Madison Dearborn Partners for $7.3 billion and has maintained a low profile ever since.
Krasny is an active donor to Jewish causes and medical research through his Circle of Service Foundation.
forbes_facts: In March 2017, Krasny reportedly paid $4.35 million for a condominium on the 50th floor of Park Tower in Chicago.
Krasny was a 28-year-old, unemployed college grad when he, after placing a $3 ad for his IBM personal computer on the paper, came up with the idea for CDW.

name: Lauren Leichtman
forbes_bio: Lauren Leichtman cofounded the buyout firm Levine Leichtman Capital Partners with her husband Arthur Levine in 1984, five years after the couple got married.
LLCP has managed $16.4 billion of institutional capital across 15 funds since inception, and currently manages $11 billion in assets.
The firm's target sectors include business services, franchising, education and training, and engineered products and manufacturing.
Successful exits have included Tropical Smoothie Cafe, Wetzel's Pretzels and Nothing Bundt Cakes.
Prior to entering private equity, Leichtman worked as a lawyer, including with the enforcement division of the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
As a couple, Leichtman and Levine share a fortune worth an estimated $2.6 billion.
forbes_facts: In October 2024, Leichtman and Levine bought the National Women's Soccer League's San Diego Wave FC for $113 million.

name: Tsao Ter-fung
forbes_bio: Tsao Ter-fung is the chairman of food and beverage company Standard Foods.
He worked for Quaker Oats in the U.S. and became head of its Taiwan operations in 1981.
In 1986 Tsao bought Quaker's Taiwan assets and set up his own business.
His Ph.D. is in food-and-chemical engineering.
His son Arthur Tsao took over the reins as CEO in 2019.
